notes: Modified cash basis village (governmental modified cash, business-type accrual). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6); transfers from the fund columns (General out 8,608, Street in 9,000, p5; net 392 on p6). Roll-forward 1,243,702 + 894,022 - 838,107 + 9,000 - 8,608 = 1,300,009; ending cash is total fund balances (includes certificates of deposit 210,106, investments 88,032 and county treasurer cash 15,848, p4). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p8), net position measure; the proprietary cash flow statement (p9) is not recorded (proprietary is for GAAP reports). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1), since it includes capital assets and debt. Detail: General Fund from the General Fund departments combining statement (pp15-16, more detailed than the p10 budget schedule, which is not recorded); Street, Youth Projects, Debt Service and CDA budget schedules (pp11-14; only an Original budget column is printed, used as budget_final). The Other (CDBG) fund and Water/Sewer funds have no schedule and are not added to detail. A handwritten-style annotation '142,936' beside the charges for services total on p16 is not part of the schedule; the printed total 142,937 is used. Read pages 1-16 of 16
